run_camera_calibration_data_collection: run the LoCoBot camera calibration script to collect images and joint angle data for calibration
create_CameraCalibration_instance: create a CameraCalibration instance that sets up the LoCoBot arm and CalibrationCamera for data collection
collect_calibration_data: collect calibration data by moving the arm through poses and capturing images at various camera pan and tilt angles
get_kinematic_chain_transforms: get the kinematic chain and transform matrices between two ROS frames relative to a reference frame
compute_camera_pose_from_ar_tag: compute the camera pan and tilt angles by looking up the transform from camera links to an AR tag
